findings.title: Read data for an unmapped register address is undefined
findings.detail: 11 reads to addresses outside the register map disagreed on returned data. Both the design and the spec-derived model agree the access is exceptional (the error indication matches on every one), so this is not a disagreement about whether the access fails. They differ only on the data accompanying the error: the design returns 0xdeadbeef, the model returns 0x0. The model reads the specification literally, and the specification does not state what data an unmapped read returns — the terms 'unmapped', 'unimplemented', 'decode_error' and 'undefined address' do not appear in it. Neither implementation is wrong; the specification did not decide.
findings.question: What must a read of an unmapped CSR address return on the data bus? Options: (a) the design's current 0xDEADBEEF, recorded in the spec as the defined response; (b) zero; (c) explicitly 'don't care', in which case validation must exclude the data field from comparison for errored accesses. Any of the three is actionable; silence is not.

evidence.example: csr_rsp[230] value: predicted [csr_rsp.read_data addr=0x2c data=0x0 err=0x1] but observed [csr_rsp.read_data addr=0x2c data=0xdeadbeef err=0x1]

findings.routing_reason: The specification does not define this behaviour; it must say, or the item stays blocked.
